Name: RukaBravo's Curly Maru 2020 reupload
Author: rukabravo
Description:
[size=3][b][[ Reupload of 2020 portrait and sprite mod of Maru with long, brown, curly hair ]][/b][/size]

Edit 2024: This mod was made before 1.5 upload, so there's no beach version. This mod may not work for 1.6 either. I made a new portrait mod with ALL vanilla villagers (but Maru looks different) check here:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16904]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16904

[/url]
[size=3]REQUIREMENTS[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url] USE THE v1.23. THEIR UPDATE v1.24 WILL NOT WORK.
[/list]
[size=3]HOW TO INSTALL[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Open the folder you downloaded. Click on whichever "install" file is referring to your Operational System. A black screen will open. Read the text: it will ask where you'd like to install - you may type 1 then enter. It will then ask whether you want to install or remove it - you may type 1 then enter. 
[*]Copy these folders:
[CP] [CP] RukaBravo's Curly Maru
ContentPatcher
PyTK

[*]Paste the folders into your Mods folder, somewhat at this path:
\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods

[*]Run the game using SMAPI (the pufferfish/chicken icon). Have fun!

[/list]
